faqs.question: What is Treqo's New Age Digital Marketing Program?
faqs.answer: A 4-month intensive, practitioner-led program where you build real campaigns using live marketing budgets for actual brands, graduating with an execution-backed portfolio.

faqs.question: Who is this program best suited for?
faqs.answer: Aspiring performance marketers, agency founders, growth leads, and creative strategists who want real execution skills instead of theoretical lecture slides.

faqs.question: Do we get hands-on experience with real budgets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every student manages real ad spend across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and automation workflows with direct practitioner supervision.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the upcoming cohort?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Apply Now' button on our website, fill in your background and goals, and our admissions team will schedule a 1-on-1 interview call.

sixDecisions.title: Six decisions that make Treqo different.
sixDecisions.subtitle: Most marketing programs teach theory from slides. We made six deliberate structural choices to run this as an active agency residency.
sixDecisions.footerNote: Enforced on every cohort since Batch 1.

decisions.title: 70% doing
decisions.description: The ratio is enforced, not aspirational. Every phase closes on a live problem, and theory alone doesn't clear it.
decisions.standardWay: 80% passive lectures, multiple-choice quizzes, and pre-recorded videos with zero real-world feedback.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: 70% hands-on campaign execution. If your ad tests don't generate real data, you cannot pass the phase.

decisions.title: Clients with something to lose
decisions.description: You work on brands with real customers to disappoint. Fictional case studies teach confidence about risk you never carried.
decisions.standardWay: Toy datasets, simulated mock businesses, and hypothetical case studies where failure has zero cost.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: You manage active ad spend for real partner businesses where poor decisions cost real brand money.

decisions.title: A fixed sequence
decisions.description: You can't position a brand you haven't understood. No à-la-carte modules the order is the curriculum.
decisions.standardWay: À-la-carte electives that let students skip hard analytics, unit economics, or attribution models.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: A non-negotiable linear sequence: you master campaign analysis and economics before touching Ads Manager.

decisions.title: AI from phase one
decisions.description: In the workflow from the start, not bolted on as a final module nobody remembers.
decisions.standardWay: Tacked on as an optional bonus module or theoretical lecture on ChatGPT prompting at the end of the course.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: Integrated into your daily workflow from day one: AI video scripting, hook variation, and audience mining.

decisions.title: Defended out loud
decisions.description: Your numbers, your logic, your revenue plan pushed on in front of people. That's the interview rehearsal.
decisions.standardWay: Submitting written PDF reports or slide decks that hiring panels never look at and mentors never critique.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: You stand up in our class and defend your live campaign CAC, ROAS, and revenue model out loud to founders.

decisions.title: 50 seats, capped
decisions.description: Small enough that there's nowhere to hide, and small enough that we know what you're bad at by week three.
decisions.standardWay: Massive 1,000+ student automated cohorts where instructors don't know your name or strengths.
decisions.treqoEnforcement: Strictly capped at 50 seats per cohort. Tutors know your exact weaknesses and campaign blindspots by week three.

mentors.title: Taught by people still doing the work.
mentors.description: Every tutor runs active accounts and active brands. When algorithms change on a Tuesday, your Wednesday session reflects it.
mentors.guaranteeText: Every mentor actively manages enterprise budgets, live client acquisition accounts, and direct-response campaigns.
